title: IMOS animal tracking virtual stores
description: Byte-reference indexes of IMOS Animal Tracking Facility (AATAMS) data, read in place from the IMOS public bucket imos-data (s3://imos-data/IMOS/AATAMS/). No data is copied. The first datasets are the MEOP-QC'd CTD profiles of satellite-relay tags on seals and turtles: one cube of the IMOS-CTD_2024 release (profiles by 1 dbar levels), and every tag of both releases as a group of its own. Drafts.
